entities.name: Adriana Vallore
entities.description: Knight of Fiora, former Captain of the Guard under King Brago, who plots to overthrow Paliano's monarchy.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: King whom Adriana served as Captain of the Guard; his sword she took after his death.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: Queen of Paliano whose coronation Adriana quit on.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker whose parting words inspired Adriana.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: City whose monarchy Adriana plots to overthrow.

events.summary: Adriana takes King Brago's sword after his death and quits as Captain of the Guard on the day of Queen Marchesa's coronation.
events.quote: She took his sword after his death and quit her job on the day of Queen Marchesa 's coronation

events.summary: Inspired by Kaya's parting words, Adriana plots to overthrow the monarchy of Paliano and build a republic with Selvala as figurehead.
events.quote: she plotted to overthrow the monarchy of Paliano and build a republic with Selvala as the figurehead

events.summary: Adriana's city guard is thrown over for troops loyal to Marchesa, and Adriana stages daring rescues of imprisoned former guards.
events.quote: Adriana staged some daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side

relations.note: Captain of the Guard under him.
relations.quote: Adriana was the Captain of the Guard under King Brago
she plotted to overthrow the monarchy of Paliano
